answer: The hotel limit for a Grade L5 employee in a Metro City such as Mumbai is Rs. 6,000 per night, excluding taxes. This amount reflects the increase introduced by the amending circular HR/CIR/2025/01, which supersedes the earlier Rs. 5,000 limit in Table 2 [S1][S4][S3].

citations.snippet: In view of the increase in hotel tariffs in the principal cities, with effect from 1 February 2025 the hotel limit for Employees in Grades L4 and L5 in a Metro City in Table 2 is increased from Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 6,000 per night, excluding taxes.
citations.label: Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy, p. 12, Circular HR/CIR/2025/01

citations.snippet: The maximum room tariff per night, excluding taxes, depends on Grade and on whether the destination is a Metro City, as set out in Table 2.
citations.label: Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy, p. 5, cl. 5.2

citations.table: Table 2: Hotel limits per night, excluding taxes
citations.snippet: Grades: L4 and L5 | Metro City: Rs. 5,000 | Non-metro city: Rs. 3,500 | International: Approved hotel at the negotiated rate
citations.label: Travel and Expense Reimbursement Policy, p. 5, Table 2
